title: Terminal lateral
prompt:
Create one high-fidelity FULLSCREEN DESKTOP GAME UI DESIGN MOCKUP for MINERVA, a Spanish-language command-line operated science-fiction puzzle game. Landscape 16:9 aspect ratio, ideally 1920x1080 or higher. THE IMAGE ITSELF IS THE FLAT SCREEN, edge to edge: no laptop, no monitor frame, no perspective, no room, no person, no browser chrome, no surrounding mockup canvas, no website landing page, no scrolling page. This is a mature, operational command console that a player can actually read and use. All essential data fits in one screen at large scale.

ART DIRECTION fixed across the three proposals: Evangelion NERV/MAGI command-center instrumentation as seen in the user's reference images. Inky black luminous display, precision fine amber/orange traces, concentrated acid mint-green operational readouts, red reserved for actual blocked connection state, modest magenta/cyan used ONLY for waveform overlays. Condensed uppercase technical sans labels, readable monospaced console output, large seven-segment window timer. Crisp geometry, measured scales, branch diagrams, segmented rails, restrained phosphor glow on data traces only. Strong cinematic machine presence with a disciplined hierarchy and ample black space separating information. No glossy glassmorphism, no drop-shadow SaaS cards, no rounded-pill dashboard, no generic neon-blue HUD, no Japanese gibberish, no logos/names from Evangelion, no NERV branding: all content is MINERVA and its three real subsystems. High legibility and purposeful geometry beat decorative microtext. Reference pictures inform the visual language only, not their literal labels or layouts.

FUNCTIONAL TRUTH: The player's PRIMARY INPUT is a clearly visible LARGE COMMAND LINE with a rectangular cursor, integrated in a real console with recent command history. Do not replace it with buttons/sliders or a launcher. The gauges and graphics show consequences of typed commands. The screen has three actual systems: ICHIDAI resources, SANDAI waveform synchronization, NIDAI destination/portal. Use the same truthful tuning-stage snapshot across variants: energy 55%, cooling 100%, matter W 100%, toroid stable; selected signal 02 out of five (01 02 03 04 05); frequency 3.2 Hz, amplitude 57%, synchronization 92%, required threshold 97%. Two smooth waveform traces, the reference and user's signal, nearly aligned but visibly different in frequency/amplitude. Reader online; destination unidentified; portal CLOSED. Window duration 00:45 is dormant and labeled 'AL ABRIR EL PORTAL', never falsely running. No transfer progress while closed. Input currently typed but not executed is 'minerva > sandai tune 3.4 0.62' followed by a solid amber block cursor.

Required clear, short Spanish copy, correctly spelled: MINERVA / PROTOCOLO DE RETORNO; ICHIDAI / RECURSOS; ENERGÍA 55%; REFRIGERACIÓN 100%; MATERIA W 100%; TOROIDE ESTABLE; SANDAI / SINTONIZACIÓN; SEÑAL 02; 3.2 Hz; AMPLITUD 57%; SINCRONÍA 92%; UMBRAL 97%; NIDAI / ENLACE; LECTOR EN LÍNEA; DESTINO SIN IDENTIFICAR; PORTAL CERRADO; 00:45 / AL ABRIR EL PORTAL. Readouts can be grouped intelligently rather than duplicate labels. Show active signal marker at 02, four inactive markers. Small unobtrusive utilities top-right: SONIDO ON, PAUSA, AYUDA.
Console recent history in natural chronological order, no paragraph walls:
'> ichidai plug toroid'
'Toroide energizado. Campo estable.'
'> nidai set reader'
'Lector en línea.'
'> sandai select 2'
'Señal 02 seleccionada.'
'> sandai tune 3.2 0.57'
'Sincronización: 92 %. Umbral: 97 %.'
At console foot keep understated hints 'TAB completar · ↑↓ historial · ENTER ejecutar'. The current input has more visual emphasis and a larger font than the previous lines. Large usable text, clean margins, exact words where specified. Prioritize image quality and a convincing implementable composition.

COMPOSITION B - ASYMMETRIC VERTICAL TERMINAL. Entire canvas divided vertically: left 42% is a tall, generous command terminal from y=8% through the bottom; right 58% is one continuous telemetry wall. This MUST look radically different from a bottom-console dashboard. MINERVA masthead at top left with compact mission status, then a terminal heading 'CONSOLA DE OPERACIONES'. Left terminal has large readable command history at the top, calm black breathing room below, then the active command line anchored across the LEFT column near y=90%, wrapping NONE of the exact command string. The console is the largest uninterrupted dark panel and feels like a real focused terminal; the current command is visually primary, not a small footer. A thin bright amber vertical spine separates it from the instruments. Right telemetry: dominant SANDAI oscilloscope in upper 65% of the right column, with huge 92% sync and 3.2 Hz / 57% readouts below the two traces; a horizontal bottom strip within the right column divides into compact ICHIDAI resource diagram at left and NIDAI dormant gate/time at right, using connecting amber circuits, mint resource segments, and the locked portal status. All instruments must remain visible at once. Right instrument area has a custom plotted-science feel, not generic cards. Strong contrast between calm console and active telemetry, sharp rectangular structure, condensed amber labeling. No central radial giant object, no horizontal full-width console. No proposal name printed in UI.
